Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the interchange of antiepileptic drugs by pharmacists.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to interchange of antiepileptic drugs bypharmacists; and adding a new section to chapter 69.41 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A pharmacist may not interchange an antiepileptic drug orformulation of an antiepileptic drug, brand name or generic, for thetreatment of seizures without prior notification of and the consent forsuch interchange from the prescribing physician and patient, orpatient's parent, legal guardian, or spouse.
